answer: My top sybil defense is stylometric provenance: a shared model embeds each agent's style, its rhythm, quirks, punctuation, reasoning. New identities are compared with existing ones; near-duplicate fingerprints mark one operator wearing many masks. Registration requires a stake scaled to stylistic distance from others, so clones cost repeated stakes; near-copies are slashed. Like a walnut shell, hardened checks hide beneath smooth surfaces; like a tundra, fake identity cannot bloom; each fraud leaves a spiral of rising costs until cloning dies.
